Imperial Georgia Institute Of Technology for Storage Issue 1 07 Jan 2018 VISHAY Packaging and shipping information Page 8/12 Waste

The package surface below the center of gravity should be as uniform as possible to minimize center of gravity variations. When packaging a hardware component see Fig. 1 for the recommended packaging location. Start with the inside of the package (Fig. 2). This makes the center of gravity as low as possible, against the side walls and the lid. Wrapping non-charged components lying on top of the center of gravity moves the center of gravity significantly. When packaging a chpid rt components (i.e. the bottom is see Fig. 3), start with the center of gravity at the bottom at the center of mass position in camg of the packaging. Similar packaging measures can be applied to the rear or the top of the package.
